Translation of Statement
by C.D.S. Tai Boo Ziang
Crim. Report
15 W
(a) 490

At 6 p.m. October 15, Ma Lien Sung, a friend of mine who
formerly served as sergeant in the Woosung Water Police, came to
my house (office ?) and told me that his aunt Sih Lee Sz had
been arrested by Police from Bubbling Well Station. I asked
him where his uncle, Sih Hai Ding was, and he replied that Sih
had gone to Haimen, near Tsungming. I therefore took him to
Bubbling Well Station where we saw Sergeant No. 26. The Foreign
Sergeant said that the woman had been charged for assaulting and
wounding
her slave girl. We then withdrew. On the following day the
woman was fined $200 and sentenced to 4 months imprisonment,
sentence to be suspended, at the Provisional Court. She was
subsequently released. I knew nothing about the judgment or
the woman's release until 6 p.m. October 18. On the latter date,
Sih Hai Ding, the woman's husband, who is my friend, called on
me stating that he had just come back from Haimen and that
a foreign detective and a Chinese from the Bubbling Well Station
had called at his (Sih's) house asking for the presence of
Sih Lee Sz at the Police Station. Sih, on the detectives
inquiring for his wife, replied that she had disappeared and
that he did not know where she was or had gone. Later at 7 p.m.
I accompanied Sih Hai Ding to the Bubbling Well Station with
the object of claiming the search property. We saw the foreign
detective who said that the Police have appealed in the case.
I did not know this appeal until I was told by the detective.
The foreign detective asked me as to the whereabouts of the
woman. In turn I asked Sih Hai Ding. Sih replied that she had
left for Tientsin. We then left the Station,
Sih Hai Ding was formerly Chief of the 2nd District Water
Police, Wusieh. I knew him about ten years ago.

C. I. D. Rog.
Please file.
Wg
25/10/29

戴步祥（C.D.S. Tai Boo Ziang）陈述之译文
刑事报告
15 W
(a) 490

10月15日下午6时，我的朋友马连松（Ma Lien Sung），前吴淞水上警察巡长，来到我家（办公室？），告诉我他的婶母施李氏（Sih Lee Sz）已被静安寺捕房的警察逮捕。我问他她的丈夫施海定（Sih Hai Ding）在哪里，他回答说施已前往崇明附近的海门。因此我带他去了静安寺捕房，我们见到了26号巡长。该外籍巡长称，该妇女被控殴打并伤害其婢女。随后我们离开。次日，该妇女在临时法庭被判罚款200元，判处监禁4个月，缓刑。她随后获释。直到10月18日下午6时，我对该判决或该妇女的释放一事均不知情。在上述日期，该妇女的丈夫、我的朋友施海定前来拜访我，称他刚从海门回来，静安寺捕房的一名外籍侦探和一名华籍人员曾到他（施的）家中，要求施李氏到警察局报到。当侦探询问其妻子下落时，施回答说她已经失踪，他不知道她在哪里或去了何处。后来在晚上7时，我陪同施海定前往静安寺捕房，目的是领回被搜查的财物。我们会见了那名外籍侦探，他说警方已对此案提出上诉。在此之前我并不知晓此上诉，是听该侦探告知才得知的。该外籍侦探向我询问该妇女的下落。我转而询问施海定。施回答说她已前往天津。随后我们离开了捕房。
施海定曾任吴淞第二区水上警察局长。我大约在十年前认识他。

刑事调查处 罗格（Rog.）
请归档。
Wg
1929年10月25日
